info.title: Mini Taxi Service
info.description:
Backend MVP of a taxi service in Almaty (KZT).

**Session in Swagger UI** (the browser keeps the HttpOnly cookie itself):

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/register`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
2. `GET /api/v1/auth/session` and copy `csrf_token`.
3. **Authorize** -> `CsrfToken`: paste the token. It is sent as `X-CSRF-Token`,
   required on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with the session.
4. `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` ends the session; its CSRF token stops working.

Errors always use the `ErrorResponse` envelope.

International format; spaces, '-' and brackets are removed: '+7 701 123-45-67' is stored as '+77011234567'.

MyProfileUpdate.description: Only these fields are writable; role, username and approval are not.

PaymentResponse.title: PaymentResponse
PaymentResponse.description: ``payment_url`` is the configured Kaspi link for ``kaspi_link``, otherwise null.

username.title: Username
username.description: 3-32 ASCII letters, digits or '_'; unique regardless of case.

password.title: Password
password.description: 10-128 characters; stored only as an Argon2id hash.

role.title: Role
role.description: Public registration creates passengers or drivers only; role 'admin' is rejected with 422 (admins are created by scripts/create_admin.py).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Plain text, 1 to 200 characters after trimming, no control characters.

driver.description: Only for the passenger and the driver while the ride is assigned, arrived or in_progress; otherwise null.

RideSummary.title: RideSummary
RideSummary.description: A list item without the route geometry; payment fields are null before completion.

RouteGeometry.title: RouteGeometry
RouteGeometry.description: GeoJSON LineString; every position is ``[longitude, latitude]``.

RouteRequest.title: RouteRequest
RouteRequest.description: Two points of a road route, in driving order.

RouteResult.title: RouteResult
RouteResult.description: Road route normalized from an external provider.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Send it as the X-CSRF-Token header with every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with this session. Valid until logout or expiry.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Server time (UTC) when the session ends.

plate_number.title: Plate Number
plate_number.description: Unique across drivers; '123 abc-02' is stored as '123ABC02'.

year.title: Year
year.description: Model year from 1980 to next year.

VehicleInput.title: VehicleInput
VehicleInput.description: The driver's one car; sending it replaces all of its fields.
